body:
## Summary

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#136.

Adds a numbered pipeline stage navigator for pipeline mode. Each entry shows the stage number, output title, action, and upload timing when the stage updates YouTube. The navigator highlights the active stage with `IntersectionObserver` and scrolls stages into view when clicked.

Review follow-up: the navigator is now a fixed overlay outside the pipeline stage section, positioned next to the main pipeline area and before the right sidebar. Its height follows its list content with only a viewport max-height guard, so it stays visible without adding empty vertical space or narrowing stage cards.

Also collected issue/PR data and implementation analysis under `docs/case-studies/issue-136`.

## Visual Verification

![Pipeline stage navigator](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-audio-recorder-with-visualization/blob/issue-136-53e7af15b8b6/docs/case-studies/issue-136/screenshots/pipeline-stage-nav.png?raw=true)

## Tests

- `npm test -- --runInBand`
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm run build`
- `CYPRESS_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8091 npm run test:e2e -- --spec cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js`

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#136
